coverage.concept: Send the structure, run the question locally

sourceRefs.rationale: The model prompt is built from dataset/column and concept/attribute metadata.
Returned queries execute in the browser over locally resident relations.
Concrete values and user text have separately supported crossings, so an unconditional privacy claim would be false.

coverage.reason: Unlike pocket-inference, the model is remote. Unlike disclosure-aperture, the shared header is a schema, a plan returns, and computation visibly occurs over retained rows.

coverage.concept: Widen the cache without losing rows

sourceRefs.locator: Section 6: Whole-relation caching with column slices
sourceRefs.rationale: Cache reuse uses exact column containment and monotonically grows one entry while preserving every row.
A partial miss acquires the union and projects without DISTINCT or ORDER BY.

coverage.reason: Cache-reuse compares identical keys. This changes the needed set, tests containment, and replaces one narrower relation with a wider relation without joining fragments.

coverage.concept: Take shared resources in one order

sourceRefs.rationale: Sorted resource names prevent circular cross-tab locking; nested holders reuse coverage rather than locking again.

coverage.reason: Unlike queue-relief, capacity does not increase. Unlike expiring-lease, there is no timer; a global resource order prevents the illustrated circular wait.

coverage.concept: Keep partial data out of the next read

sourceRefs.rationale: Mutations poison tables before execution; failed partial writes remain unreadable until full reload.

coverage.reason: Unlike revision-restore, the point is refusing reads of potentially partial state. It is not a rollback: only a complete reload clears invalidity.

coverage.concept: Keep one record per entity

sourceRefs.rationale: Membership is materialized but attribute values stay virtual; correlated subqueries preserve one row per individual.

coverage.reason: Unlike keyed-row-zipper, this is not a two-table row join. A unique spine fixes output grain before repeated observations are aggregated, avoiding join fan-out.

coverage.concept: Say how repeated observations become one value

sourceRefs.rationale: Seven explicit collapse rules and divergent NULL handling make the rule itself part of a record field meaning.

coverage.reason: Field-conflict-choice chooses among authored alternatives by human decision. This calculates a deterministic field from repeated observations under a stated rule, preserving order and missingness.

coverage.concept: Refresh facts while keeping human work

sourceRefs.rationale: Narrow upserts preserve user state, skip no-ops and flag missing keys rather than deleting them.

coverage.reason: Unlike field-conflict-choice, no human chooses a winner between competing fields. The update mask structurally excludes human state, and a missing source does not mean deleting a person or closing a case.

coverage.concept: Combine the grants that actually apply

sourceRefs.rationale: Qualifying candidates combine by max rank, while restriction removes app defaults and group shares may require app access.

coverage.reason: Unlike capability-matrix, this computes a maximum over eligible grants and explains why a candidate is excluded. It is neither first-match precedence nor a blanket role inheritance ladder.

coverage.concept: Save the change and its delivery obligation together

sourceRefs.rationale: The data write and outbox append share one local transaction.
The roadmap explicitly describes the engine as unbuilt.

coverage.reason: Journal-receipts starts with an existing outbox and closes obligations after acknowledgment. This explains how the obligation is created atomically with the source mutation before any network activity.

coverage.concept: Continue after the acknowledged byte

sourceRefs.rationale: Resumable transfers persist acknowledged byte progress so interrupted uploads can continue.

coverage.reason: Retry-backoff repeats whole attempts. This retains a confirmed prefix and resumes by byte offset, so interruption does not restart the entire file.

coverage.concept: Recover cells from page geometry

sourceRefs.rationale: Three different page-structure signals recover cell organization; the later region spec keeps auto detection outstanding.
Automatic table detection remains a separate outstanding phase.

coverage.reason: Unlike schema-mapping, field names are not translated. Cell structure is recovered from two-dimensional page evidence before textual data becomes a grid.

coverage.concept: Review a number near two labels

sourceRefs.locator: The proximity experiment; Shape 2; User flow
sourceRefs.rationale: Proximity pairing can silently misassociate labels; the design requires uncertainty flags and inspectable source positions.

coverage.reason: Unlike keyed-row-zipper, labels are associated by spatial evidence rather than equal keys. Unlike location-uncertainty-boundary, uncertainty concerns document interpretation, not a position on Earth.

coverage.concept: Carry the unit and qualifier with the number

sourceRefs.locator: Shape 1; The observations schema; Model assistance
sourceRefs.rationale: Prose observations retain subject, unit, time and qualifier, while production method and confidence are independent.

coverage.reason: Unlike word-reveal, the action changes a sentence into an observation schema with explicit semantic roles, not merely typography. Value and unit cannot detach from period or qualifier.

coverage.concept: Read the same fields across repeated sections

sourceRefs.rationale: Repeated headings with run-in labels can form a table even without a printed grid.

coverage.reason: Unlike schema-mapping, the field labels already match. The animation reveals a tabular structure concealed by repeated prose layout and preserves absent cells.

coverage.concept: Turn each measurement into a row

sourceRefs.rationale: A true table can be kept wide or reshaped to one row per number.
Different regions can normalize to a common observation schema with retained units and provenance.

coverage.reason: Unlike source-merge, no datasets converge and no values are combined. Output grain changes from one row per subject to one row per subject-measure pair.

coverage.concept: Check that the saved region still points to the same content

sourceRefs.locator: Data model / Why geometry rather than an ordinal index
sourceRefs.rationale: Table numbering can change with detector versions; persisted geometry plus fingerprint notices source drift.

coverage.reason: Unlike revision-restore, nothing rolls back. The saved geometric locator stays fixed while a content-identity test detects drift that table numbering alone cannot detect.

coverage.concept: Freeze the selected data for a published view

sourceRefs.rationale: Publishing materializes configured slices and loads published dependencies separately.
Published snapshot ownership is scoped to dashboard and revision.

coverage.reason: Disclosure-aperture selects fields for one handoff. This also freezes a revision and shows a later live edit diverging from that immutable publication, rather than implying a live share.

coverage.concept: One filter changes only the subscribed views

sourceRefs.rationale: Global filters have all/selected/none subscriptions and compose separately from local filters.

coverage.reason: Linked-parameter-rehearsal applies affine equations to quantities. This applies an equality predicate to row membership across explicit view subscriptions and preserves an independent reference denominator.

coverage.concept: Apply the row condition before transfer

sourceRefs.rationale: The roadmap proposes predicate/column pushdown.
The current engine has no pushdown or capability-driven planning; this must remain a generic planned concept.

coverage.reason: Unlike a generic data-pipeline, selection occurs before the boundary and only the matching rows are transferred. It differs from column-cache growth, which retains every row.

coverage.concept: The breaks change the map

sourceRefs.rationale: Classification and mandatory no-data rendering are distinct from normalization.

coverage.reason: Population-normalized-map changes the measure by introducing a denominator. This keeps all values fixed and changes only classification thresholds, exposing a different cartographic choice.

coverage.concept: Make symbol area match the value

sourceRefs.rationale: The GIS design defaults proportional-symbol radius to square-root scaling so symbol area encodes value.

coverage.reason: Unlike bar-race, quantity is encoded by area without reordering. Unlike point sizing by radius, the square-root relationship is the explanatory action.

coverage.concept: A cluster is the same points grouped

sourceRefs.rationale: Clustering is a distinct symbology over underlying points.

coverage.reason: Unlike plexus-field or radial-network, cluster membership is explicit, count-conserving and reversible. These are grouped observations, not connections or epidemiological clusters.

coverage.concept: Count each point in one grid cell

sourceRefs.rationale: Hex/grid binning aggregates point observations into fixed geographic cells.

coverage.reason: Unlike catchment-union-gaps, a disjoint regular partition assigns every point once rather than testing coverage by overlapping service polygons. Unlike heatmap, counts are exact and cell-bounded.

coverage.concept: Keep small-cell counts undisclosed

sourceRefs.rationale: Aggregate-only policy enforces minimum counts and forbids exact point layers.

coverage.reason: Unlike disclosure-aperture, an explicit numerical release rule is applied to aggregate cells, with zero, suppression and no data distinct. No source point or location is ever exposed.

coverage.concept: Account for the rows that cannot be mapped

sourceRefs.rationale: Conversion returns reasoned dropped-row counts instead of silently filtering invalid coordinates.

coverage.reason: Unlike cell-normalization, rejected values are not automatically repaired. This is a coordinate-specific validation with complete dropped-row accounting and no silent removal.

coverage.concept: Transform coordinates before combining layers

sourceRefs.rationale: CRS reprojection is required before incompatible spatial coordinates can be combined.

coverage.reason: Unlike GIS layer intersection, the action aligns coordinate systems before overlay. Identity is stable even though coordinate numbers change.

coverage.concept: Remove detail without moving the kept vertices

sourceRefs.locator: Sections 10 Tier 4 and 13 polygon payload risk
sourceRefs.rationale: The design calls for zoom-based simplification to bound geometry detail.

coverage.reason: Unlike chart-focus-edit, actual geometry detail is reduced under a stated algorithmic tolerance. The original trace remains visible so simplification is inspectable.

coverage.concept: Travel time follows the network

sourceRefs.rationale: Travel-time catchments use an origin, mode and explicit durations and are saved as reproducible snapshots.

coverage.reason: Catchment-union-gaps starts from supplied polygons. This derives reachability from weighted network cost, showing why a travel-time catchment is not a distance circle.

coverage.concept: Show displacement as an approximation

sourceRefs.rationale: Sensitivity policy includes jitter/centroid displacement separately from aggregate-only release.

coverage.reason: Location-uncertainty-boundary depicts uncertainty already present in evidence. This intentionally changes a display copy under a supplied disclosure policy and labels the difference.

coverage.concept: A smooth surface depends on its radius

sourceRefs.rationale: Heatmap symbology has a weight, radius and ramp, distinct from clustering and binning.

coverage.reason: Spatial-grid-binning assigns each point once to an exact count cell. This spreads each contribution across neighboring cells and makes radius a visible modeling choice.

coverage.concept: A buffer is a distance rule

sourceRefs.rationale: Buffer and distance analysis are explicit geometric operations, distinct from travel-time isochrones.

coverage.reason: Catchment-union-gaps combines supplied coverage polygons. This derives a buffer from a distance rule and classifies points without inferring service use or routes.

coverage.concept: Keep the late value that changes the column

sourceRefs.rationale: The fixture tests a late prose value after numeric rows to prevent aborted imports or dropped rows.

coverage.reason: Cell-normalization edits explicitly supplied characters. This changes a proposed column type in response to late evidence while refusing to change or discard any cell.

coverage.concept: Probe cheap resident state before persistent cache and source

sourceRefs.rationale: Two cache tiers precede source acquisition.

coverage.reason: The existing hit/miss action already explains reuse; additional tier names are contextual metadata rather than a new stock algorithm.

coverage.concept: Separate optional raw-data transfer from metadata-only planning

sourceRefs.rationale: Concrete values and text cross through a separately supported gate.

coverage.reason: The aperture already expresses an explicit subset leaving a boundary; AI context adds intent and caveats rather than a new action.

coverage.concept: Metadata sync is separate from optional bulk-data upload

sourceRefs.rationale: Dataset metadata sync and opt-in file bytes are distinct boundaries.

coverage.reason: Same selected-field contract, with a meaningful metadata-versus-content binding.

coverage.concept: Installed model supports local query planning

sourceRefs.rationale: Offline WebLLM uses a local context window and compact aliases.

coverage.reason: The resident-model primitive already covers this computation boundary without a new cartridge reskin.

coverage.concept: Retain irreplaceable source documents locally

sourceRefs.rationale: PDF extraction is lossy; original documents may need retention separately from extracted tables.

coverage.reason: Existing local retention choreography is sufficient; the source/derived distinction is supplied content.

coverage.concept: Boundary-code joins retain unmatched keys

sourceRefs.rationale: Boundary joins report unmatched keys and distinguish exact from normalized-name matching.

coverage.reason: A geographic key join uses the existing equality-join mechanism; changing rows into polygon cards would be only a reskin.

coverage.concept: Every extracted observation traces to its source region

sourceRefs.rationale: Review rows link to page regions and carry extraction provenance.

coverage.reason: The existing source peelback is already the explanatory action for inspection.

coverage.concept: Normalize typographic noise without changing numerical meaning

sourceRefs.rationale: PDF cell cleanup handles symbols and markers before typing, with special ambiguity rules.

coverage.reason: The preset already edits specific authored cell characters; source adds important edge-case constraints.

coverage.concept: A map export carries its reading furniture

sourceRefs.rationale: Printed map output carries legend, source attribution and explanatory context.

coverage.reason: Report assembly already carries multiple source excerpts into a shareable artifact.

coverage.concept: Compose several views from shared data

sourceRefs.rationale: Reusable visualizations and an Explorer result can become dashboard blocks.

coverage.reason: Existing assembly makes composition visible; it needs use-case metadata, not a duplicate dashboard preset.

coverage.concept: Offline readiness depends on every required dataset

sourceRefs.rationale: Offline readiness compares the dashboard dependencies to locally cached datasets.

coverage.reason: All-required dependency gating is already the latch contract.

coverage.concept: Show online and offline capability differences explicitly

sourceRefs.rationale: Local operations and remote server procedures have different availability.

coverage.reason: The existing four-state matrix is the clearest compact explanation of capability boundaries.

coverage.concept: Map dataset columns into domain-specific case fields

sourceRefs.rationale: Case fields are authored mappings over contributing dataset columns.

coverage.reason: Field correspondence is already schema-mapping; entity-grain assembly is separately new.

coverage.concept: QETL mediator and connector adapters

sourceRefs.rationale: Wrappers adapt diverse sources to one query loader.

coverage.reason: Shared entry and adapter boundaries are conveyed by existing typed pipeline/source motifs; no unique new action.

coverage.concept: Authorize before reading cached data

sourceRefs.rationale: Authorization precedes either cache probe.

coverage.reason: Permission computation plus a gated choice covers this ordering without another pipeline.

coverage.concept: Public and workspace cache isolation

sourceRefs.rationale: Principal and snapshot ownership keep data contexts distinct.

coverage.reason: Explicit boundaries and snapshot identity already cover the useful concept.

coverage.concept: No upfront full ETL required

sourceRefs.rationale: Relations are acquired when named by a query.

coverage.reason: Existing reuse gains on-demand acquisition context through the enrichment.

coverage.concept: Nested virtual datasets reuse a held lease

sourceRefs.rationale: A nested query reuses lock coverage instead of reacquiring.

coverage.reason: A lock invariant belongs with coordination rather than a separate call-stack animation.

coverage.concept: Virtual datasets are queries over sources

sourceRefs.rationale: A virtual relation is acquired by executing its defining SQL.

coverage.reason: Existing pipeline plus virtual-value assembly covers derivation; nested recursion is not needed in six seconds.

coverage.concept: Sequential acquisition when dependencies share state

sourceRefs.rationale: Acquisitions are intentionally sequential for nested virtual dependencies.

coverage.reason: Dependency readiness and exclusive order cover the rationale.

coverage.concept: Quota-pressure eviction and retry

sourceRefs.rationale: Cache writes evict old entries on quota error and retry once.

coverage.reason: Replacement and retry motifs already cover bounded storage pressure; no measured memory claim.

coverage.concept: Unknown SQL references fail closed

sourceRefs.rationale: Incomplete dependency analysis cannot safely authorize execution.

coverage.reason: One gate with explicit refused outcome is already covered.

coverage.concept: One implementation of shared query execution

sourceRefs.rationale: Explorer, maps, dashboard and case reads share the query engine.

coverage.reason: Hub-and-spokes is adequate architecture orientation; no new stock process.

coverage.concept: Definition version and source freshness identity

sourceRefs.rationale: Version and definition tokens are intended identity parts but freshness is not wired.

coverage.reason: Freshness caveat belongs in cache enrichment and source-identity comparison, without claiming current implementation.

coverage.concept: Case type versus case membership

sourceRefs.rationale: Schema declarations and stored individual membership are separate.

coverage.reason: Mappings and unique membership already show this division.

coverage.concept: Array field values preserve source order

sourceRefs.rationale: Array values use source file row order.

coverage.reason: Value aggregation contract and explicit ordered observation rail cover this invariant; array-output extension can be later metadata.

coverage.concept: Draft case-type review and confirmation

sourceRefs.rationale: Proposed drafts can be edited, created or discarded, with a legacy direct-creation caveat.

coverage.reason: Human revision plus field correspondence covers the documented review action.

coverage.concept: Compensating cleanup after partial multi-step insert

sourceRefs.rationale: Client-side writes can be followed by compensating deletion on failure.

coverage.reason: A failure path with a named corrective action covers this; atomic-outbox-commit must not be used to imply transactionality.

coverage.concept: Case detail provenance

sourceRefs.rationale: Computed values retain their dataset source.

coverage.reason: The source-inspection primitive already explains attributable fields.

coverage.concept: Missing source contribution is NULL, not dropped entity

sourceRefs.rationale: The spine stays complete and missing attributes become typed NULL.

coverage.reason: Core entity-spine verification explicitly covers this.

coverage.concept: Multi-dataset joins and cross-product queries

sourceRefs.rationale: Planned cross-source queries connect concepts, datasets and open data.

coverage.reason: Join and source convergence already cover the general mechanism.

coverage.concept: Configurable statuses and controlled vocabularies

sourceRefs.rationale: Workspace-defined status sets and field enumerations are proposed.

coverage.reason: Authored status sequences and field definitions are existing stock concepts; no shipped workflow claim.

coverage.concept: Assignment and case responsibility

sourceRefs.rationale: Assignment to a user or group is proposed.

coverage.reason: Responsibility handoff already covers the general process; assignment is not claimed built.

coverage.concept: Comments and activity history

sourceRefs.rationale: Comments and state-change logs are proposed.

coverage.reason: Existing review trail/source history covers the conceptual purpose.

coverage.concept: Explicit relationships between case types

sourceRefs.rationale: Object properties between entities are proposed.

coverage.reason: Relationship graph already covers authored edges, with no inferred reasoning.

coverage.concept: Class hierarchy and subsumption

sourceRefs.rationale: Optional case-type hierarchy is planned.

coverage.reason: Nested membership windows can explain authored subsets; no reasoner is implied.

coverage.concept: Per-app roles and reusable role groups

sourceRefs.rationale: Roles are independently assigned per application through named matrices.

coverage.reason: A two-dimensional option/capability contract already fits role presets.

coverage.concept: User groups and share principals

sourceRefs.rationale: Users, groups and workspace may be share principals.

coverage.reason: Membership graph plus grant composition already represents applicability.

coverage.concept: Private/internal/public audiences are distinct

sourceRefs.rationale: Audience depends on restriction, shares and independent publication.

coverage.reason: A matrix and explicit publication audience explain these axes; no fourth reskin.

coverage.concept: Restriction does not itself mean private

sourceRefs.rationale: Explicit non-owner shares retain internal access even when default app grants are off.

coverage.reason: New grant composition explicitly preserves shares after restriction.

coverage.concept: Owner-only privacy excludes administrator content reads

sourceRefs.rationale: Owner-private resources exclude broad admin read paths.

coverage.reason: An explicit exception to a general administrator rule is already covered.

coverage.concept: Counts without reading private content

sourceRefs.rationale: Admins may see private-resource counts without reading those resources.

coverage.reason: Count-only disclosure is a content binding; do not imply anonymization.

coverage.concept: Atomic make-private postcondition

sourceRefs.rationale: Share removal and restriction occur atomically with rollback if incomplete.

coverage.reason: The shared atomic latch is the same conceptual mechanism; bind generic paired effects if expanded later.

coverage.concept: Storage access must enforce the same resource boundary

sourceRefs.rationale: Protecting database rows alone leaves a separate object-storage read path.

coverage.reason: Boundaries plus all-path gating explain the requirement without another lock metaphor.

coverage.concept: Limited resource-only guest access

sourceRefs.rationale: Planned guests reach specifically shared resources without app-wide roles.

coverage.reason: Explicit grants and scope narrowing cover the useful concept.

coverage.concept: Workbook file grant and selected tab

sourceRefs.locator: What is real; Test 1; One non-obvious requirement
sourceRefs.rationale: A picked file grant and selected tab identity control acquisition.

coverage.reason: Selecting a bounded tab and gated file access is existing scope/decision behavior.

coverage.concept: Refresh a token before connector acquisition

sourceRefs.rationale: Expired access tokens refresh before selected file access.

coverage.reason: Temporary authorization and retry are existing primitives, without claiming access-token equivalence to all leases.

coverage.concept: Import CSV/XLSX into local analytical format

sourceRefs.rationale: File loaders produce local Parquet for shared query consumers.

coverage.reason: Format transformation and authored value cleanup already cover the general import path.

coverage.concept: Cloud-synced versus local-only document policy

sourceRefs.rationale: Original PDF and extracted table remain local in offline-only mode.

coverage.reason: Retention and selected upload boundaries are covered by enrichments.

coverage.concept: User-drawn PDF region selection

sourceRefs.rationale: Manual boxes and auto-detected tables feed the same region object.

coverage.reason: The existing aperture precisely narrows content by authored selection.

coverage.concept: Classifier evidence with human override

sourceRefs.rationale: Shape classification includes evidence and supports an override.

coverage.reason: A reasoned branch with a user choice is already represented; no opaque AI judgment scene.

coverage.concept: Multi-page matching headers union by schema

sourceRefs.rationale: Regions with equal headers append rows into the same natural table.

coverage.reason: Source convergence plus consistent field alignment covers row union; no implicit deduplication.

coverage.concept: Natural output versus observations output

sourceRefs.rationale: Shape and matching columns decide availability; user choice survives reparse.

coverage.reason: Wide-to-long plus explicit choice covers meaningful row-shape change.

coverage.concept: Natural-mode review before losing provenance columns

sourceRefs.rationale: Natural mode omits provenance fields and requires flagged rows to be resolved or accepted.

coverage.reason: Required review latch and traceability capture this boundary.

coverage.concept: Scanned document versus no detected table

sourceRefs.rationale: No text layer is distinct from zero candidate structures.

coverage.reason: Distinct unavailable conditions are covered without implying OCR.

coverage.concept: Ambiguous number units and suffixes

sourceRefs.rationale: Accounting negatives and percentages need explicit normalization.

coverage.reason: Existing normalization enrichment and observation units cover the difference.

coverage.concept: Imported reports retain publication context

sourceRefs.rationale: Document title/date/report identity supports cross-report analysis.

coverage.reason: Provenance and observation keys carry reporting context.

coverage.concept: Charts preserve field meaning across mark changes

sourceRefs.rationale: Series conversion retains key/label/color while changing mark-specific defaults.

coverage.reason: A chart refinement context fits the existing same-data presentation change contract.

coverage.concept: Exact axis bounds and tick intervals

sourceRefs.rationale: Fixed domains and explicit tick arrays preserve authored scale choices.

coverage.reason: Existing chart and ruler presets already require explicit nonclipping scales.

coverage.concept: Chart render limits disclose truncation

sourceRefs.rationale: Charts cap rendered rows and issue a warning.

coverage.reason: Shown subset plus retained outside-context caption explains truncation without pretending complete data.

coverage.concept: Manual/SQL/natural-language query modes

sourceRefs.rationale: Three input modes share one query artifact with sync warnings.

coverage.reason: Input-mode comparison and local-execution story cover this; full editor synchronization is too detailed.

coverage.concept: Local and global filters compose independently

sourceRefs.rationale: Local filters layer on subscribed global filters.

coverage.reason: Scoped predicate application plus set intersection cover the semantic composition.

coverage.concept: Unsaved changes block publication

sourceRefs.rationale: Publishing reads persisted configuration and is gated on saved state.

coverage.reason: Prerequisite completion is the latch contract.

coverage.concept: Pending generated blocks deduplicate before absorption

sourceRefs.rationale: Buffered blocks keep identity and do not duplicate or resurrect after removal.

coverage.reason: Stable identity and acknowledged absorption use existing mechanisms; runtime mount behavior is not a new scene.

coverage.concept: Map rows, geometry and style are independent axes

sourceRefs.rationale: Source selection, geometry binding and symbology are separate model choices.

coverage.reason: Existing comparison and correspondence can introduce axes; no need to animate a three-card architecture chart.

coverage.concept: Point-in-polygon aggregation and spatial intersection

sourceRefs.rationale: Points may be joined to administrative regions.

coverage.reason: Existing spatial set selection computes exact membership over supplied geography.

coverage.concept: Count versus population-normalized map

sourceRefs.rationale: Rate normalization changes the mapped measure.

coverage.reason: Already directly covered with explicit numerator/denominator arithmetic.

coverage.concept: No reported data differs from zero

sourceRefs.rationale: Missing regions require a separate style and label.

coverage.reason: Both new contracts make missing and zero distinct.

coverage.concept: Map area-of-interest draw-to-filter

sourceRefs.rationale: An authored area restricts map query results.

coverage.reason: Existing spatial intersection is the actual operation.

coverage.concept: Map temporal filtering

sourceRefs.rationale: Time slider selects observations across a window.

coverage.reason: Existing place-time and map-time linked views preserve identity and unknown time.

coverage.concept: Distance and area measurement

sourceRefs.rationale: Map tools measure explicit geometric quantities.

coverage.reason: Ruler-based measurement and distance derivation already cover this; no actual geodetic calculation implied.

coverage.concept: Map annotation and printable context

sourceRefs.rationale: Annotations and furniture help communicate map interpretation.

coverage.reason: Annotation is contextual authored evidence, already supported by report/source motifs.

coverage.concept: Frozen isochrone geometry survives service outage

sourceRefs.rationale: Saved polygons reload without requesting the routing service.

coverage.reason: Snapshot versus live source is already new; the geography is a binding.

coverage.concept: Map legend frozen with saved classification

sourceRefs.rationale: Persisted breaks avoid disagreement between live, embedded and exported views.

coverage.reason: Snapshot consistency and explicit breaks cover the mechanism.

coverage.concept: Offline basemap preparation and no-basemap fallback

sourceRefs.rationale: Map readiness depends on saved tiles or a clearly labeled tile-free mode.

coverage.reason: Caching and conditional capabilities cover the useful distinction without pretending all map operations work offline.

coverage.concept: Independent map layer visibility and order

sourceRefs.rationale: Layer arrays determine visual stack order.

coverage.reason: Layer display assembly is a presentation-only variation; no new explanatory algorithm found.

coverage.concept: Map persistence, bookmarks and dashboard embedding

sourceRefs.rationale: Map resources retain configuration and can be reused as saved views.

coverage.reason: Saved configurations and composition use established primitives.

coverage.concept: Geometry encodings WKT/WKB/GeoJSON

sourceRefs.rationale: Different representations decode into common map geometry.

coverage.reason: Representation conversion is existing mapping/pipeline vocabulary, not a new meaningful animation.

coverage.concept: Privileged native process boundary

sourceRefs.rationale: Filesystem, native query and secrets stay behind a typed process interface.

coverage.reason: The source is a draft platform architecture; existing boundary/comparison diagrams are enough.

coverage.concept: Regenerate disposable derived files from retained originals

sourceRefs.rationale: Only derivable parquet may be evicted while original sources stay.

coverage.reason: Stored originals and re-acquisition already express lossless retention of source content.

coverage.concept: Last-write-wins conflict choice

sourceRefs.rationale: The draft sync engine compares timestamps to choose a winner.

coverage.reason: Chosen alternatives can illustrate the result; this is not endorsed as a general conflict policy.

coverage.concept: Offline edit, reconnect, acknowledge

sourceRefs.rationale: Queued local mutations drain when connectivity returns.

coverage.reason: The accepted pair already separates local retention from remote acknowledgment.

coverage.concept: Model download and device readiness

sourceRefs.rationale: Offline model download has progress and persisted failure state.

coverage.reason: Dependency readiness plus installed model covers the user-visible mechanism.

coverage.concept: Compact aliases preserve query identity

sourceRefs.rationale: Stable short aliases reduce schema prompt size and rewrite back to table identifiers.

coverage.reason: Exact name correspondence is existing schema mapping; token budget is not visually proportional without measured data.

coverage.concept: Clarify loaded terms before choosing a metric

sourceRefs.rationale: Ambiguous measures, scopes and terms prompt a neutral clarification.

coverage.reason: Existing scope and decision motifs preserve human definition rather than automated labeling.

coverage.concept: Discover local categorical values before writing a filter

sourceRefs.rationale: Local distinct values resolve exact stored category spellings; user choices may then cross the boundary.

coverage.reason: Known-value selection and explicit crossing are existing mechanisms, with no unconditional metadata-only claim.

coverage.concept: Repair an invalid generated query using error feedback

Contrast filtered views with an unchanged all-records reference
